ruleDefinitions.name: Process Memory Dump via RdrLeakDiag.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the Microsoft Windows Resource Leak Diagnostic tool "rdrleakdiag.exe" to dump process memory

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rdrleakdiag\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RdrLeakDiag\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/memdmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-memdmp.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fullmemdmp.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/o\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/p\\ .*")))
